title: "reading_data_from_the_web"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-15"
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
library(chromote)
```



##Import NSDUH
從URL去讀你需要的檔案，你需要提前知道你自己要哪些資料！
```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
drug_use_html = read_html(url)

drug_use_html
```


##Pull the tables out
 slice(-1) 用來扣掉第一行
```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |>
  slice(-1) 

marj_df
```



##Import some star wars data
pull in the html
你用read html，只能讀html上面的，但只是“讀”
```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
swm_html
```


Next, selector gadget 這裡報錯，沒跟到lol
1.要先確定電腦有chrome，老師有說要有chrome才會成功
2.要確定r上面也能run chrome的環境喔
```{r}
library(rvest)

swm_title_vec =
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |>
  html_text()

swm_title_vec

swm_metascore_vec =
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |>
  html_text()

swm_metascore_vec

swm_runtime_vec =
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".base .ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |>
  html_text()

swm_runtime_vec

length(swm_title_vec)
length(swm_metascore_vec)
length(swm_runtime_vec)

swm_df =
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    score = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )

swm_df
```


```{r}
test_local =
  minimal_html(
    "<html><body><h1>R test successful</h1></body></html>"
  )

test_local |>
  html_elements("h1") |>
  html_text()
```





##Use APIs
getting a CSV
  content("parsed") 如果是CSV，就提取出來，或者用類似的方式（？）
```{r}
nyc_water_df = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv") |> 
  content("parsed") |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
nyc_water_df
```



get a json file
這裡報錯了？
```{r}
nyc_water_json =
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json")

nyc_water_json |>
  content("text") |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
nyc_water_json
```



Look at some pokemon!
```{r}
pokemon_json = 
  GET("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1") 
  
  
pokemon_data= 
  pokemon_json |> 
  content()

pokemon_data[["name"]]
pokemon_data[["height"]]
pokemon_data[["abilities"]]
```
